label: the local runner spawns bun install with no bunfig - the Coolify build path resolves from the open registry with lifecycle scripts enabled, which is the state this change exists to end
find: write_build_bunfig(project_dir)  # the floor, laid at the spawn

label: the floor respects a project-supplied bunfig instead of displacing it - a template change could switch minimumReleaseAge off and nothing would notice
bunfig drops out of the install fingerprint - introducing the floor moves no hash, so every already-built site skips the reinstall and keeps its unfloored node_modules while the suite stays green
daytona re-derives the floor instead of aliasing it - two constants that agree today and drift the first time one is edited
lifecycle scripts are re-enabled in the floor - the file is still written, still named bunfig.toml, and a postinstall runs beside the artifact we are about to deploy
the release-age floor is cut to a minute - a compromised fresh publish of an already-vetted package resolves, which is the exact attack the allowlist cannot catch
